title: F-Strings Conversion Challenge
instructions: Convert messy concatenation to clean f-strings. In the final task, you'll build your own f-string from scratch!
steps: Task 1: Convert the intro message to an f-string.
Task 2: Convert the character stats to an f-string.
Task 3: Convert the shopping cart to an f-string.
Task 4: Use the variables provided to create the f-string: "Soylent Green is people!"
starterCode:
name = "Alex"
age = 28
city = "Paris"

# Task 1: Convert this to an f-string
message1 = "Hello, my name is " + name + ", I am " + str(age) + " years old, and I live in " + city + "."

# Task 2: Convert this to an f-string
character = "Wizard"
health = 85
mana = 120
message2 = "Character: " + character + " | Health: " + str(health) + " | Mana: " + str(mana)

# Task 3: Convert this to an f-string
item = "Magic Wand"
price = 49.99
quantity = 2
message3 = "Item: " + item + " | Price per item: $" + str(price) + " | Total: $" + str(price * quantity)

# Task 4: Construct the famous movie line using an f-string
food_wafer = "Soylent Green"
additive = "people"

dinner_time = ???
solution:
name = "Alex"
age = 28
city = "Paris"

message1 = f"Hello, my name is {name}, I am {age} years old, and I live in {city}."

character = "Wizard"
health = 85
mana = 120
message2 = f"Character: {character} | Health: {health} | Mana: {mana}"

item = "Magic Wand"
price = 49.99
quantity = 2
message3 = f"Item: {item} | Price per item: ${price} | Total: ${price * quantity}"

food_wafer = "Soylent Green"
additive = "people"
dinner_time = f"{food_wafer} is {additive}!"
hints: Task 1-3: Replace the + signs and str() calls with f"... {variable} ..."
Task 4: Your f-string should look like f"{var1} is {var2}!"
Make sure you include the 'f' before the first quote mark!
Include your own print statements to check your progress in the terminal

tests.name: Check message1 conversion
Check message2 conversion
Check message3 conversion
Check dinner_time construction
